title: Ezra Prays About Intermarriage

questions.question: What problem did the officials report to Ezra?
options: The people of Israel have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands
questions.correctAnswer: The people of Israel have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:1 (ESV): "...The people of Israel... have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands..."

questions.question: What had the people done specifically?
options: Taken some of their daughters to be wives for themselves and for their sons
questions.correctAnswer: Taken some of their daughters to be wives for themselves and for their sons
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:2 (ESV): "For they have taken some of their daughters to be wives for themselves and for their sons..."

questions.question: How did Ezra react to this news?
options: Tore his garment and his cloak, pulled hair from his head and beard, and sat appalled
questions.correctAnswer: Tore his garment and his cloak, pulled hair from his head and beard, and sat appalled
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:3 (ESV): "As soon as I heard this, I tore my garment and my cloak and pulled hair from my head and beard and sat appalled."

questions.question: At what time did Ezra rise from his fasting and pray?
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:5 (ESV): "And at the evening sacrifice I rose from my fasting..."

questions.question: What did Ezra say about their guilt?
options: Our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens
questions.correctAnswer: Our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:6 (ESV): "...for our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens."

questions.question: What did God give them to leave a remnant?
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:8 (ESV): "But now for a brief moment favor has been shown by the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant..."

questions.question: What metaphor did Ezra use for the remnant?
options: A secure hold (or peg) within his holy place
questions.correctAnswer: A secure hold (or peg) within his holy place
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:8 (ESV): "...and to give us a secure hold within his holy place..." (Some translations say peg/nail).

questions.question: Did Ezra say they were slaves?
options: Yes, we are slaves. Yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, we are slaves. Yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:9 (ESV): "For we are slaves. Yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery..."

questions.question: Why did God command them not to intermarry?
options: To not seek their peace or prosperity, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land
To keep the bloodline pure only
questions.correctAnswer: To not seek their peace or prosperity, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:12 (ESV): "...and never seek their peace or prosperity, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land..."

questions.question: Who gathered to Ezra?
options: Everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:4 (ESV): "Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel... gathered around me..."

questions.question: Which peoples are mentioned as abominations?
options: Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, Amorites
questions.correctAnswer: Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, Amorites
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:1 (ESV): "...the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites."

questions.question: Who were foremost in this trespass?
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:2 (ESV): "...and in this faithlessness the hand of the officials and chief men has been foremost."

questions.question: What did Ezra say God had punished them less than?
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:13 (ESV): "...seeing that you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve..."

questions.question: What argument did Ezra present about breaking the commandments again?
options: Would you not be angry with us until you consumed us?
questions.correctAnswer: Would you not be angry with us until you consumed us?
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:14 (ESV): "...would you not be angry with us until you consumed us, so that there should be no remnant..."

questions.question: How did Ezra describe God at the end of his prayer?
options: O LORD, the God of Israel, you are just
questions.correctAnswer: O LORD, the God of Israel, you are just
questions.explanation: Ezra 9:15 (ESV): "O LORD, the God of Israel, you are just..."

key_verse_text: O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens.
